title: Saqrmisc Features Reference
text: Publication-ready correlation matrix. Features: - Lower triangle significance stars - Optional confidence intervals (show_ci = TRUE) - Partial correlation matrix - Multiple themes (default, colorful, minimal) - Custom titles digits

title: Saqrmisc Features Reference
text: Comprehensive group comparison function. Statistical Tests: - 2 groups: t-test (parametric) Mann-Whitney U (nonparametric) - 3+ groups: ANOVA (parametric) Kruskal-Wallis (nonparametric) - Bayesian t-test ANOVA (bayesian = TRUE) - Equivalence testing/TOST (equivalence = TRUE) Post-hoc Tests: - Tukey HSD (posthoc_method = "tukey") - Games-Howell (posthoc_method = "games-howell") - Pairwise Wilcoxon (nonparametric) - Adjustable p-value correction (p_adjust_method) Analysis Modes: - -group (compare_mode = "") - Default - Within-group (compare_mode = "within") - Test factors within category Pivot Tables: - Compact table categories columns (pivot = TRUE) - Statistics: mean, mean_sd, median, n (pivot_stat) - p-value effect size column (p (ES)) - Stratified pivot tables repeat_category Stratified Analysis: - Repeat analysis level variable (repeat_category) - Combined summary tables - Filter levels threshold explicit list Output: - Publication-ready gt tables - ggstatsplot visualizations - Multiple plot styles (points, boxplot, bar, violin) - ANOVA text reports (APA style)

title: Introduction to Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization
text: Saqrmisc package includes ten main functional areas: Group Comparisons (compare_groups) Correlation Matrix (correlation_matrix) Full Correlation Tables (correlations) Descriptive Statistics (descriptive_table) Categorical Frequency Tables (categorical_table) Data Transformation (center, scale_vars, standardize, reverse_code) Missing Data Analysis (missing_analysis, replace_missing) Model-Based Clustering (clustering) Categorical Variable Analysis (mosaic_analysis) Network Estimation (estimate_single_network)

title: Introduction to Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization
text: functions use consistent quoted-string API variable names:
code: # Variable names as quoted strings compare_groups(data, category = "gender", Vars = c("score1", "score2")) correlations(data, Vars = c("x", "y", "z"), group_by = "group") center(data, Vars = "score", group_by = "cluster")  # NULL for auto-selection of all numeric variables correlations(data)  # Correlates all numeric variables correlation_matrix(data)  # Matrix of all numeric variables

title: Introduction to Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization
text: compare_groups() function creates comprehensive comparison plots using ggbetweenstats compare groups across multiple variables.

title: Introduction to Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization
code: # Generate sample treatment data set.seed(456) treatment_data <- data.frame(   patient_id = 1:200,   group = sample(c("Control", "Treatment"), 200, replace = TRUE),   anxiety = rnorm(200, mean = 5, sd = 1.5),   depression = rnorm(200, mean = 4, sd = 1.2),   stress = rnorm(200, mean = 6, sd = 1.8),   study_site = sample(c("Site_A", "Site_B", "Site_C"), 200, replace = TRUE),   gender = sample(c("Male", "Female"), 200, replace = TRUE) )  # Basic comparison analysis comparison_results <- compare_groups(   data = treatment_data,   category = "group",   Vars = c("anxiety", "depression", "stress"),   plots = TRUE,   table = TRUE )  # View results comparison_results$plots$group_vs_anxiety comparison_results$summary_table  # Stratified analysis by study site stratified_results <- compare_groups(   data = treatment_data,   category = "group",   Vars = c("anxiety", "depression"),   repeat_category = "study_site",   plots = TRUE,   table = TRUE )

title: Introduction to Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization
text: Stratify multiple variables simultaneously using c():
code: # Stratify by both study_site AND gender multi_stratified <- compare_groups(   data = treatment_data,   category = "group",   Vars = c("anxiety", "depression"),   repeat_category = c("study_site", "gender"),   table = TRUE )  # Results are organized by combined groups (e.g., "Site_A | Male")

title: Introduction to Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization
text: Use repeat_levels analyze specific subgroups:
code: # Analyze only Site_A and Site_B filtered_results <- compare_groups(   data = treatment_data,   category = "group",   Vars = c("anxiety", "stress"),   repeat_category = "study_site",   repeat_levels = c("Site_A", "Site_B"),   table = TRUE )

text: correlation_matrix() function creates publication-ready correlation tables significance stars optional heatmap visualization. Supports bivariate, partial, semi-partial correlations.
code: # Basic correlation matrix (all numeric variables) correlation_matrix(mtcars)  # Specific variables with title correlation_matrix(   data = mtcars,   Vars = c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp", "wt"),   title = "Motor Trend Car Correlations" )  # With confidence intervals correlation_matrix(   data = mtcars,   Vars = c("mpg", "hp", "wt"),   show_ci = TRUE )  # Partial correlations (controlling for other variables) correlation_matrix(   data = mtcars,   Vars = c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp"),   type = "partial",   title = "Partial Correlations" )  # Spearman correlations with Bonferroni correction correlation_matrix(   data = mtcars,   Vars = c("mpg", "cyl", "disp"),   method = "spearman",   p_adjust = "bonferroni" )  # Full matrix with heatmap result <- correlation_matrix(   data = mtcars,   Vars = c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp"),   triangle = "full",   heatmap = TRUE )  # Access the heatmap plot result$heatmap

text: "clusters": profile, heatmap, distribution, sizes. "diagnostics": certainty (relative entropy), avepp (average posterior probability), projection (principal components). text: Category filtering (min_count) applied pooled table splitting, every panel shows rows columns. residual colour scale shared across panels, given shade means standardized deviation everywhere. Panel strips carry stratum size, since panels drawn equal width. New by_label, min_stratum_n, p_adjust, facet_ncol, facet_show_n seed arguments. Per-stratum p-values corrected multiplicity (Benjamini-Hochberg default) reported beside raw values. stratified fit gains class mosaic_stratified fields strata_summary, strata_residuals, strata_table overall_summary, last pairing pooled test Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test association conditional stratifier.
